title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure kidnaps his family.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, a man who cannot stay put as he is addicted to going on new adventures, breaks up with his girlfriend, Shaina, who is a Warsaw-based psychiatrist, just to pursue his daredevil ambitions.

desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Dhamaal
